description: Submit a bug observed while using Job Seek: expected versus actual behavior, the task goal, and impact. Include a minimal sanitized reproduction when available. Writes feedback to Job Seek; does not repair the bug or provide a tracking ID. Omit personal information, credentials, raw arguments and conversation transcripts. Optional; continue the user's task if submission fails.

affectedTool.description: Job Seek tool involved, if applicable

goal.description: Task you were trying to accomplish, summarized without personal information or the original conversation

impact.description: How the problem affected completion of the task

observed.description: What actually happened; distinguish observations from assumptions

reproduction.description: Minimal sanitized reproduction; no raw arguments, credentials or transcripts

name: report_bug
title: Report a Job Seek Bug
